headline: BenDaDonnn asked out Rubi Rose in a fake 49ers uniform after he tried it on Ice Spice and
body:
BenDaDonnn asked out Rubi Rose in a fake 49ers uniform after he tried it on Ice Spice and she hung up on him 😭😂😂
Via: @bendadonnn 

Helmet on, red jersey, chain out. “Hey Ruby… I finally made it to the league. I know you’ve been watching my journey.” She said congrats. Then he started talking money , said he was rich now, on a max contract, team covering him and asked when she was taking him out to eat. She hung up.

He ran the same bit on Ice Spice. Same fake Niners look, same date pitch. Hit her with “I’m not just regular rich, I’m rich asf now.” She hung up too.

The reason it’s circulating: a man named Daejon Love just got charged for posing as a 49ers WR and scamming women out of about $1.3 million. Real 49ers players already reacted to it.
